skill.name: internal-comms
skill.description: Guides AI assistants in drafting internal communications, including 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, status reports, leadership updates, and incident updates.
skill.summary: Drafts structured internal updates using documented company communication formats.

content.value_statement: Teams need concise updates that match company expectations and reach the right audience. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through proven internal communication formats.
actual_capabilities: Selects a format for 3P updates, newsletters, FAQs, and general internal messages.
Prompts for missing audience, scope, tone, and formatting context.
Structures 3P updates around Progress, Plans, and Problems.
Creates company newsletter sections from supplied or authorized source material.
Drafts FAQ answers that cite official communications when available.
limitations: Does not provide direct access to Slack, email, calendars, or documents by itself.
Requires user-provided context or authorized connected tools for factual updates.
Does not verify confidential, legal, or HR-sensitive content automatically.
May need company-specific editing before messages are sent broadly.

use_cases.title: Prepare Company Newsletters
use_cases.description: Summarize major milestones, leadership announcements, and broad employee updates for Slack or email.

use_cases.title: Create Weekly 3P Updates
use_cases.description: Turn team progress, next plans, and blockers into a short leadership-ready update.

use_cases.title: Answer Employee Questions
use_cases.description: Group repeated employee questions and draft clear answers with links to official sources.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a 3P Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a 3P update for [team] covering [dates]. Use these notes: [notes]. Keep each section to one to three sentences.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Newsletter
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a company newsletter for [time period]. Use these announcements, links, and milestones: [materials]. Group related updates into clear sections.

prompt_templates.title: Build an FAQ
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these employee questions and source notes: [questions and sources]. Draft concise FAQ answers and flag any answer needing official approval.

prompt_templates.title: Adapt a Leadership Message
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite this leadership update for [audience] with a [tone] tone. Preserve facts, clarify decisions, and highlight requested actions: [draft].

output_examples.input: Notes for the mobile team include shipped onboarding fixes, next week payment work, and blocked design approvals.
output_examples.output:
Mobile Team (July 1 to July 5)
Progress: Shipped onboarding fixes and reduced first-session errors.
Plans: Focus on payment flow testing next week.
Problems: Design approvals are blocking final checkout updates.

output_examples.input: Company notes include a new executive hire, launch metrics, and employee questions about roadmap timing.
output_examples.output:
Company Announcements
- We welcomed a new operations leader this week.
- We reached the first launch milestone for the customer portal.
Employee Questions
- Roadmap timing remains under review, and product leadership will share updates after planning closes.

output_examples.input: Employee questions ask why the office policy changed and where to find the final decision.
output_examples.output:
Question: Why did the office policy change?
Answer: The policy changed to align team schedules and improve planning. See the official workplace announcement for details.

best_practices: Provide approved source notes, links, dates, and audience details before drafting.
Ask for missing team names, time periods, tone, and approval requirements.
Review sensitive announcements with the responsible owner before publication.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent metrics, decisions, or leadership statements.
Do not publish broad updates without checking confidential or restricted information.
Do not use newsletter guidance for narrow team-only updates.

faq.question: What formats does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQ answers, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, and incident reports.

faq.question: Does it connect to company tools?
faq.answer: No. It can use connected tools only when the host assistant already has authorized access.

faq.question: Can it write from raw notes?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide notes, links, dates, and audience details, and it will structure the communication.

faq.question: Will it verify facts?
faq.answer: It organizes and clarifies supplied information, but users must verify facts before sending messages.

faq.question: Is it suitable for sensitive announcements?
faq.answer: It can draft sensitive messages, but legal, HR, or executive owners should review them first.

faq.question: Can it adapt tone for different audiences?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the audience and tone requirements, and it can adjust clarity, detail, and formality.
